Description: th Kent Tekulve, the side-arm reliever of the Philadelphia Phillies, pitched two innings for a 7-5 victory over the San Francisco Giants in his 1000th game. Only one other player in baseball history, Hoyt Wilhelm, had reached the one-thousand milestone to date.
, Orel Hershiser pitched ten additional shutout innings to continue his scoreless streak to fifty-nine.
, the Chicago Cubs played the New York Mets during the first ever Wrigley Field night game.
